description: Subcomponent for `v-audio` used to display the transport bar.

props.playing: Applies the correct icon to the default play button.
props.duration: Total duration of the audio, used to calculate the displayed time.
props.volume: Volume value passed to the underlying control and slots.
props.playbackRate: Current playback rate. Only meaningful together with `playbackRates`.
props.playbackRates: Rates offered by the playback speed menu. Leaving it empty hides the menu.
props.variant: Layout of the control bar. `mini` renders play and time only; `hidden` renders nothing.
props.hideWaveform: Hides the waveform. With `seek-target="container"` this turns the whole component into the seek surface.
props.skipInterval: Seconds moved by the skip buttons. `0` hides them. The value is announced in the buttons' labels.
props.download: Shows a download button. A string value is used as the downloaded file name.
props.splitTime: Splits time into elapsed and remaining on each side of the waveform.
props.timeDisplay: Format of the single time display. Ignored when `split-time` is set.
props.playIcon: Icon used for the play action.
props.pauseIcon: Icon used for the pause action.
props.stopIcon: Icon used for the stop action.
props.volumeIcon: Icon used when audio is audible.
props.muteIcon: Icon used when audio is muted.
props.downloadIcon: Icon used for the download action.
props.skipForwardIcon: Icon used for the skip forward action.
props.skipBackwardIcon: Icon used for the skip backward action.
props.color: General color applied to icons, the played waveform and sliders.
props.pills: Makes the container transparent and shows inner actions in separated boxes.
props.detached: Moves the container below so it reads as a separate surface.
props.floating: Introduces visual spacing from the container boundaries.
props.waveformProps: Pass props through to the `v-audio-waveform` component. Accepts an object with anything from [v-audio-waveform](/api/v-audio-waveform/#props) props, camelCase keys are recommended.

events.update:playing: Emitted when the playing state changes.
events.update:progress: Emitted when the playback position changes.
events.update:volume: Emitted when the volume value changes.
events.update:playbackRate: Emitted when the playback rate changes.
events.skip: Emitted when a skip action is triggered. Carries the target position as a percentage.
events.scrubStart: Emitted when the user starts dragging the waveform.
events.scrubEnd: Emitted when the user stops dragging the waveform.
events.click:stop: Emitted when the stop button is clicked.
events.click:download: Emitted when the download button is clicked.

slots.default: Replaces the entire contents of the control bar.
slots.prepend: Additional content on the left within the control bar.
slots.append: Additional content on the right within the control bar.
slots.waveform: Replaces the waveform between the controls and the time display.
slots.time: Replaces the time display. Receives the elapsed, remaining and total time already formatted.

exposed.toggleMuted: Toggles the muted state of the audio.
